methods.name: multi-scale target attention YOLO (MSTA-YOLO)
methods.summary: MSTA-YOLO is a deep learning model for landslide detection that reconstructs the YOLOv11 architecture. It incorporates a Receptive Field Attention (RFA) module to enhance multi-scale feature extraction and replaces the traditional boundary regression loss with Normalized Wasserstein Distance (NWD) loss to improve small target detection. Additionally, it streamlines the architecture by removing redundant C2PSA blocks.
methods.source: Bingkun Wang, Jiali Su, Jiangbo Xi, et al.
methods.verbatim: To address these challenges, we propose a multi-scale target attention YOLO model (MSTA-YOLO).
